title: provider_presence input
description: The adapter reports what its upstream server declares now, so the network notices when its tools change without a new agent.json.

upstream_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 (hex) of ekl-json-1 of the declared tools of the upstream tools/list, sorted by name, each as {name, description, inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations} with absent members null (PROTOCOL.md §5.1; vectors/upstream-fingerprint.json).
